name: Uzzi
overview: The name Uzzi appears multiple times in Scripture, primarily associated with leadership and priestly roles within Israel. He is identified as a priest and son of Bukki in the Levitical genealogy (1 Chronicles 6:5-6, 51), emphasizing his role in the priestly line. Additionally, Uzzi is noted as a valiant leader among the sons of Tola and Bela, highlighting his significance as a tribal head and overseer (1 Chronicles 7:2, 3, 7). These references collectively portray Uzzi as a figure of spiritual and tribal authority during the time of Israel's early monarchy and restoration.
